reason: I already take magnesium at night at home, so the on-the-go sachet solves a problem I don't have. The named lab and batch report are good, but I'm not switching a working routine for $25-30 a month.
objection: I don't need a travel format since I take it at home, and it's made in China, so I'd want to see the actual lab report before trusting that 200 mg is really in there.
would_change_my_mind: A price near what I pay now (around $15-18 for 30 days) plus a real, readable lab report for the batch that I can check before ordering.
